questions.question: Four words have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
questions.solution:
The meaning of the given words in the option are as follow:

1) Create → to cause something new to happen or exist.

**2) Disband → ****to stop existing as a group; to separate.**

3) Assemble → something together in a group.

4) Construct → to build or make something

Meaning of option 1, 3 and 4 is positive or to make some thing but option 2 meaning is negative or to extract something.

Hence, 'Disband' is odd among all.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some fishes are horses

2. Some horse are kites.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some horses are fishes.

II. Some kites are fishes.

III. Some kites are horses

options.text: ALL conclusions I, II and III follow.
Only conclusion I and II follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3552b8cd9a2d5b8812a72e1d6750f0d3cb121027bcb8926d7beb0a23b19e797b.png] 

Explanation:

I. Some horses are fishes → True (Some fishes are horses)

II. Some kites are fishes →False (it is possible but not definite)

III. Some kites are horses → True (Some horse are kites)

Hence, only conclusion I and III follow.

questions.question: Arun is celebrating his birthday today. In his next birthday, he will be twice his age that was 12 years ago. How old is Arun today?
questions.solution:
Let the age of Arun is X.

12 year ago age of Arun is X - 12.

According to the question age of Arun will be twice of his age that was 12 year ago.

X + 1 = 2 × (X - 12)

X + 1 = 2X - 24

2X - X = 24 + 1

X = 25

Hence, Arun is 25 year old.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

46, 92, 69
questions.solution:
The logic is:

46, 92, 69 → 92 – 46 = 46; 92 – 69 = 23

First difference is double of second difference.

Similarly,

1) 56, 78, 60 → 78 – 56 = 22; 78 – 60 = 18

First difference is not equal to double of second difference.

2) 48, 82, 63 → 82 – 48 = 34; 82 – 63 = 19

First difference is not equal to double of second difference.

3) 50, 88, 59 → 88 – 50 = 38; 88 – 59 = 29

First difference is not equal to double of second difference.

4) 34, 72, 53 → 72 – 34 = 38; 72 – 53 = 19

First difference is equal to double of second difference.

Hence, ‘34, 72, 53’ is the correct answer

questions.question: If in a code language PATNA is coded as 260 and GOA is coded as 69, then how will you code RANCHI?
questions.solution:
Position of letters in English alphabet series according to English alphabet series.

**Insert the alphabet table:**

The pattern followed here is :

Numerical position of letter get added and multiply by total number of letter to get the code.

PATNA :

P (16) + A (1) + T (20) + N (14) + A (1)

16 + 1 + 20 + 14 + 1 = 52

52 × 5 = 260

GOA :

G (7) + O (15) + A (1)

7 + 15 + 1 = 23

23 × 3 = 69

Similarly,

RANCHI :

R (18) + A (1) + N (14) + C (3) + H (8) + I (9)

18 + 1 + 14 + 3 + 8 + 9 = 53

53 × 6 = 318

Hence, '318' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Which symbol is on the face opposite the face showing '(' ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47be58bb3709f39e6a0ba3076cb4f7fc6852e541ac50c29c9e3acebd29ea9892.png]
questions.solution:
Given,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47be58bb3709f39e6a0ba3076cb4f7fc6852e541ac50c29c9e3acebd29ea9892.png] 

In the first dice '&' and '$' phase are adjacent to '(' phase so these phases are not opposite to '(' phase.

In the second dice '*' and '#' phase are also adjacent to '(' phase so these phases are not opposite to '(' phase.

Now from the third dice only '+' phase has left which is opposite to '(' phase.

Hence, '+' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two numbers should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

3 × 9 + 5 - 18 ÷ 7 = 24
questions.solution:
Checking the given alternatives:

1) 18 and 9

Given equation : 

3 × 9 + 5 - 18 ÷ 7 = 24

After interchanging according to potion 1.

3 × 18 + 5 - 9 ÷ 7 = 24

3 × 18 + 5 - 2.571= 24

54 + 5 - 2.571 = 24

56.429 ≠ 24

2) 5 and 7

Given equation : 

3 × 9 + 5 - 18 ÷ 7 = 24

After interchanging according to potion 2.

3 × 9 + 7 - 18 ÷ 5 = 24

3 × 9 + 5 - 3.6 = 24

27 + 5 - 3.6 = 24

 28.4 ≠ 24

3) **9 and 7**

**Given equation : **

**3 × 9 + 5 - 18 ÷ 7 = 24**

**After interchanging according to potion 2.**

**3 × 7 + 5 - 18 ÷ 9 = 24**

**3 × 7 + 5 - 2 = 24**

**21 + 5 - 2= 24**

** 24 = 24**

4) 3 and 5

Given equation : 

3 × 9 + 5 - 18 ÷ 7 = 24

After interchanging according to potion 2.

5 × 9 + 3 - 18 ÷ 7 = 24

5 × 9 + 3 - 2.571 = 24

45 + 3 - 2.571 = 24

 45.429 ≠ 24

Hence, '9 and 7' is the correct answer.
